candidate.answerReason: There are three negative factors and no zero factors, so the product is negative, choice C. Its value is -120.

methods.label: Count the negative factors
methods.explanation: When multiplying several nonzero factors, there are 3 negative factors (an odd number), so the product is negative. Its absolute value is \(2\times3\times4\times5=120\), so the product is \(-120\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 sign rule for several factors and elementary odd-even recognition.
